title: Patch: the Stinkyscape weapon, Miner, Drone Core and Asteroid families share their test bodies instead of copying them card by card

**Issue #3483 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3483: Patch: the Stinkyscape weapon, Miner, Drone Core and Asteroid families share their test bodies instead of copying them card by card
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Stinkyscape has families of near-identical cards: Beam, Cannon, Repeater and Flak at three power levels, five Miners, ten Drone Cores and four Asteroids. Their test files are copies of each other with different numbers, about 2,400 lines of tests repeated line for line. A change to a family means editing every copy, and copies drift apart. Once this is built, each family's tests are written once, and each card's file keeps short tests that call them with its own numbers, so every card still has its own tests.

## Why

- 31 script files hold 226 tests in 4,311 test lines. 2,387 of those lines match the family's first file line for line (a survey's diff). For example, Beam v3 and Beam v4's test modules differ in 56 lines out of about 350: the card id, the damage numbers and one extra block.
- `r1862000_the_enemy_hero_is_never_offered_and_is_refused` is written out 18 times, `its_death_fuses_nothing_it_is_no_starship_piece` 15 times, and `its_health_is_doubled` 16 times. The last only rereads printed Radiant stats, which the cards README's #1125 rule says a card test should not do.
- The crate already shares test helpers (`weapon_board`, `hits` and `next_turn_of` in `crates/cards/src/lib.rs`; #1463, #2961).

## Proposal

- Move each family's test bodies into `#[cfg(test)]` helpers in `crates/cards`, beside `weapon_board`, taking the card id and its numbers as arguments.
- Each card file keeps a thin `#[test]` per case that calls the helper. CLAUDE.md rule 6 still holds, and every `r<n>` test name stays in the file its ruling's `proven_in` lists.
- Drop the `its_health_is_doubled` tests wherever another test in the same file exercises the Radiant face.
- Leave every line above `#[cfg(test)]` alone: `crates/cards/build.rs` counts those lines into what cards show players (`CODE_LINES`, the busted and complicated lists), so merging the scripts would change play.

## Where it lands

`crates/cards/src/lib.rs` (or a test helper module beside it) and the 31 family files under `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every test name that held an `r<n>` token before is still in the same file, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` runs the same tests minus only the dropped printed-data ones, which the pull request lists.
- [ ] No line above `#[cfg(test)]` changes in any script, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` reports no card that plays differently.
- [ ] The families' test code shrinks by at least 1,500 lines.
- [ ] fmt and clippy pass.

## Size and risks

Medium, about 32 files, test code only. A card's tests read less well on their own. Coverage stays put, since the same cases still run.

No new test files: every wrapper in the 31 files above is the test. Dropped (no replacement): `its_health_is_doubled` in c050, c054, c058, c051, c055, c059, c052, c056, c060, c053, c057, c061. Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` (full crate), plus per-file runs like `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c050`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

- [ ] Every `r<n>` test name is still in its original file and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes with the same tests minus only the 12 listed dropped tests, named in the final report.

- [ ] Family test code shrank by ≥ 1,500 lines (measured per step 11).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

## Risks

- Drone cores VII–X and I/II/V are mechanically distinct (discard, corvette, battleship pile, fill-board, kept scripts), so their test bodies stay per-file except the float/setup helpers; the 1,500-line target is met from weapons, miners, asteroids, flak and the drone helpers above. Do not force unlike bodies into one helper.
- Seeds are passed through as parameters, never regenerated, so statistical sweep tests (flak `SEEDS`, miner replay equality) run identical RNG streams.
- Kept-script tests (`script_v0_5_11`, `script_v0_5_9f`, VII's `script_v0_5_11o`) differ per file, so they are passed as `fn() -> CardScripts` arguments, never moved.
- Flak v3's sweep is ported from its tuple shape to the shared `Seen` shape with `rounds = 1` (rerolled always false; its tests assert only counts/differed as today).

## Open questions

None.
```
